title: [3.4] Bolus Progress notification on Wear does not show total amount of insulin to be delivered
symptom: After Bolus Progress refactoring in 3.4, the notification on Wear only shows the amount delivered so far, not the total amount to be delivered.
cause: The Bolus Progress refactoring removed the string that included the total amount, and the new common string only shows delivered amount. The Dash driver uses a workaround to keep its own string.
fix: Philoul suggests adding a dedicated `BolusProgressData.wearStatus` and building the additional string with total amount in EventOverviewBolusProgress. A pull request #4480 is proposed.
evidence_quote: I think the dedicated `BolusProgressData.wearStatus` and build the additional string with total amount in EventOverviewBolusProgress is probably the best solution
